entries.title: Gull (pet)
entries.reason: Shellbane gryphon's DropsLine uses name='Gull (pet)', which matches neither of infobox_item's two rows for that page: item_name 'Gull' (id 31285, default_version=true) and item_name 'Gulliver' (id 31287, an easter-egg/nickname version, default_version=false) — a name-matching gap between the drop-table label and the item's own infobox name, not a genuine multi-version collision the default_version signal can resolve. The wiki's own default_version points at id 31285 ('Gull'); recorded here rather than taught to the general resolver for one known case.
